facts.fact: The strategy states that the civil registration system SIGA, in production, runs on a cloud platform from the University of Aveiro in Portugal, i.e. this state system is hosted outside STP.
facts.system: SIGA hosted at University of Aveiro cloud

systems.system: Centro de Dados (government data centre, INIC)
SIGA hosted at University of Aveiro cloud

note: Government data centre (built 2008 with Brazil's SERPRO; state data centre partly in operation from 2017 fibre project) is state-use, not for hire, and no hosted systems are named; proposed Government Data Centre is a plan.
